name: Shadcn Address Autocomplete
summary: Address autocomplete input component for React built on the Google Places API and shadcn/ui.
description: An address autocomplete component built with the Google Places API (new) and shadcn/ui, in a Next.js and Tailwind CSS project with Zod validation. The repo holds the component and a demo app with local setup steps; the hosted demo runs on mock data and real use needs a Google API key.
